hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$r"; p=.; case "$f" in */web/*) p=web;; esac; out=$(npx tsc --noEmit -p "$p" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | head -30 >&2; exit 2; }

jq -e .stop_hook_active >/dev/null && exit 0; r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$r"; out=$( { npx vitest run --changed --passWithNoTests && (cd web && npx vitest run --changed --passWithNoTests); } 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | tail -40 >&2; exit 2; }
